verses.text: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from the evil man; Preserve me from the violent man:

segments.text: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from the evil man;
Preserve me from the violent man:

verses.text: Who devise mischiefs in their heart; Continually do they gather themselves together for war.

segments.text: Who devise mischiefs in their heart;
Continually do they gather themselves together for war.

verses.text: They have sharpened their tongue like a serpent; Adders’ poison is under their lips. [Selah

segments.text: They have sharpened their tongue like a serpent;
Adders’ poison is under their lips. [Selah

verses.text: Keep me, O Jehovah, from the hands of the wicked; Preserve me from the violent man: Who have purposed to thrust aside my steps.

segments.text: Keep me, O Jehovah, from the hands of the wicked;
Preserve me from the violent man:
Who have purposed to thrust aside my steps.

verses.text: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; They have spread a net by the wayside; They have set gins for me. [Selah

segments.text: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords;
They have spread a net by the wayside;
They have set gins for me. [Selah

verses.text: I said unto Jehovah, Thou art my God: Give ear unto the voice of my supplications, O Jehovah.

segments.text: I said unto Jehovah, Thou art my God:
Give ear unto the voice of my supplications, O Jehovah.

verses.text: O Jehovah the Lord, the strength of my salvation, Thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

segments.text: O Jehovah the Lord, the strength of my salvation,
Thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

verses.text: Grant not, O Jehovah, the desires of the wicked; Further not his evil device, lest they exalt themselves. [Selah

segments.text: Grant not, O Jehovah, the desires of the wicked;
Further not his evil device,
lest
they exalt themselves. [Selah

verses.text: As for the head of those that compass me about, Let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

segments.text: As for the head of those that compass me about,
Let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

verses.text: Let burning coals fall upon them: Let them be cast into the fire, Into deep pits, whence they shall not rise.

segments.text: Let burning coals fall upon them:
Let them be cast into the fire,
Into deep pits, whence they shall not rise.

verses.text: An evil speaker shall not be established in the earth: Evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

segments.text: An evil speaker shall not be established in the earth:
Evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

verses.text: I know that Jehovah will maintain the cause of the afflicted, And justice for the needy.

segments.text: I know that Jehovah will maintain the cause of the afflicted,
And justice for the needy.

verses.text: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: The upright shall dwell in thy presence.

segments.text: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name:
The upright shall dwell in thy presence.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
